text:
julia: alert — noticed anomalous cross-region KMS Decrypt spikes from maintenance role at 03:22 UTC, affecting eu-west and ap-south.
mike: details?
toni: logs show Decrypt allowed for principal pattern `arn:aws:iam::123:role/infra-*` against multiple CMKs, some of which have the policy condition Principal: "*" due to a templating bug in last week's key-policy import.
security-bot: alert triggered: kms_decrypt_rate{principal="infra-rotator"} > baseline * 40 at 03:22. Investigating.
julia: CloudTrail snippet (redacted):
```
{"eventTime":"2026-09-14T03:22:11Z","eventName":"Decrypt","userIdentity":{"arn":"arn:aws:iam::123:role/infra-rotator"},"requestParameters":{"keyId":"arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123:key/rot-2024"},"responseElements":{"decision":"Allow"}}
```
mike: why was star principal in key policy?
toni: we had an automated migration that applied a JSON template with an empty variable, causing Principal to render as "*" for three CMKs. It was merged by infra-bot during a mass update.
julia: impact: potential over-broad decrypt access. We need immediate containment. Options: (1) revoke the infra-rotator role, (2) patch key policies to remove wildcard, (3) rotate impacted CMKs, (4) suspend rotator service. Tradeoffs: rotation/regeneration is costly and may cause mTLS handshake failures if certs unseal with new keys.
mike: short-term: patch key policies to remove wildcard and explicitly allow only known role ARNs; also revoke the bot that performed the mass update to prevent re-apply.
toni: I'll open policy PRs and tag as emergency. https://git.internal/infra/kms/pull/789
infra-ops: approved emergency policy patch at 03:29 UTC.
security-bot: applied policy patch 03:31 UTC. Scan shows wildcard removed from 3 CMKs; principal list set to explicit ARNs: ["arn:aws:iam::123:role/infra-rotator","arn:aws:iam::123:role/keystore-service"].
julia: SOC: please collect CloudTrail/keystore logs 02:00-04:00 for forensics; tag with incident id INC-1788501234.
soc: acknowledged, starting export.
mike: second phase: schedule CMK rotation for the three affected keys with rolling cert reissue window and 15m stagger to avoid mass handshake failures. Also add pre-rotation test that verifies rotator principal can still Decrypt the new key.
toni: will add CI check to policy-as-code: fail any PR that creates Principal: "*" or wildcard role ARN patterns. Also add a pre-apply linter that rejects empty template variables.
julia: monitoring change: new rule to alert on unusual cross-region decrypt patterns and on any CMK policy change that widens principals. Example detection pseudo-query:
```
change_events(key_policy_modified) and added_principal matches "\\*|/.*/infra-.*/"
```
mike: add automatic pause for mass key-policy updates: if >5 keys changed in one run, require two human approvals and block infra-bot.
toni: compliance note: no evidence of decrypts by external principals; all activity attributed to infra accounts. SOC recommends rotating keys and keeping 90-day audit retention.
soc: added to incident tracker, will lead internal review and contact compliance if needed.
julia: post-incident actions: 1) policy-as-code guard, 2) mass-change throttling, 3) preflight that queries CMK policy before apply, 4) CMK rotation runbook w/ backoff to prevent mTLS mass failure, 5) add sampling eval that decrypts a synthetic blob across regions before mass-update.
mike: also add a constraint in the keystore service so that any Decrypt allowing principal must be explicitly listed in IAM/metadata for the requesting pod; fail otherwise.
toni: opened postmortem INC-1788501234 and assigned RCA tasks.
oncall: closing thread for now; re-open if SOC finds suspicious decrypts. :shield:
